paragraphs.text:
You glance over the items but you do not have an eye for 
antiquities. As near as you can tell, everything is as it appears to 
be and as Mr. Warren claims.

Still, as you look over the notebook, you notice it contains 
personal accounts as well as academic findings. It will likely be 
a good source of information regarding Prof. Harris.
